card.name: Linking words in drug interaction results
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as after, in, when, was or increased that follow a reported rise in drug exposure (AUC, Cmax, peak levels). They sit just before the mention of co-administration or a single dose of the other drug.

modes.label: after / when co-administered
modes.description: Words like after or when that follow an increase in AUC or Cmax and lead into the other drug being given.
modes.example: Tolvaptan AUC was 5.4 times as large and C max was 3.5 times as large<< after>> co-administration of tolvaptan

modes.label: increase in peak levels
modes.description: The word in after a percent increase, leading into peak plasma levels of a drug.
modes.example: with a 60% increase<< in>> peak metformin plasma and whole blood

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and the pole seems to prepare the text that names the interacting drug or condition.
card.plain: It marks the small word in interaction sentences where a rise in drug levels is linked to giving another drug.
